display_long_description:
A blended learning program for competence development beyond pure professional skills. The mission of COMPETENCE+ is to provide training for current and future employees in the public transport sector with a blended modular learning concept. The newly acquired skills and knowledge can and should be directly applied in everyday training and work. This is the VR experience that accompanies the E-learning material available on https://competencepluselearning.eu/
